body:
AgentRelay 1.1.5 (build 20)

## Changes

- Keeps terminal and editor content live while moving workspace cards and reduces terminal reflow during swap previews.
- Makes joined-window swaps follow the pointer and remain reliable across repeated drags.
- Restores regular toolbar symbol sizes and individual command accessibility labels.
- Adds inline session-name editing and persistent custom session colors.
- Wraps editor lines by default, with a per-window toggle.
- Adds a native Settings window and improves terminal font loading.
- Exports complete Copilot conversation history independently of terminal scrollback and improves working/idle detection.
- Adds an experimental Metal terminal renderer; CoreGraphics remains the default. 120 fps is not established.

## Requirements

macOS 14 or later. Universal app for Apple Silicon and Intel Macs. tmux and the native MCP bridge are bundled; install the command-line tools for the AI providers you use separately.

Developer ID signed and notarized by Apple.

## Download integrity

Asset: `AgentRelay-macOS.zip`

SHA-256:

```text
052468d7877eeab4dc0a85d345937ed5078f7e9d25a156e3dcae048fa90b39b1
```
